description: Async. Trigger analysis for existing BrandCompetitor rows that are pending or failed. Use competitor_add to create new rows; use this to retry failed ones. Rows added via probe-classify, SEO competitors, or cluster approval are "pending" and NOT analyzed until this is called: 50 credits each unless the free slot is unused; subscription required after that. Returns { operationId, status } — poll get_job until state=completed. Typically takes ~2–5 min.

brandCompetitorIds.description: IDs of existing BrandCompetitor rows to (re-)analyze (1–20).

name: competitor_analyze
